claims.text: The top-level record is a closed object requiring schema lineage.event/v1, id e- plus 16 hex chars, lamport at least 1, ledger main, one of 13 kinds, op_id and request_sha256.
The allOf array holds one if/then branch per kind const, pinning each payload shape; the memory.put branch requires agent_id and a unit $ref to mem_unit.schema.json with an optional run_id.
The evidence array is unique, capped at 64 items, and each item closes over exactly a bounded path and sha256; the chain is carried by prev_sha256 and sha256 64-hex fields.

decision.rule: Change here when a new event kind, an event field, or a payload shape for an existing kind needs to change.
decision.failure: A committed event fails shape validation, a kind has no matching allOf branch, or evidence entries exceed the 64-item cap.

questions.q: Where does the event schema pin the payload shape for each kind const?
Where should I change the evidence item bounds for event records?
Where can I debug why an event record fails validation despite a valid kind?
